text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — after adding customer-visible fields (actor_ip, org_id, resource_state) to audit schema we saw ingest spikes and ES indexing errors this morning. Showing backpressure on the audit pipeline. Any quick mitigation ideas?
Akshat Patel: saw the alerts. spikes ~3x throughput and ES bulk rejects. cost jumped to ~$12k/day for audit indices yesterday :grimacing:
Lee Gomez: which producers are impacted? host-level or customer-side event validation?
Maria Chen: both. Some customers send very chatty events every few seconds. Plus we added required KMS signing per event — increases CPU and latency.
Nora Li: KMS sign per event is the killer. We should batch-sign or sign payload blobs. signing 1k req/s to our HSM causes throttles.
Daniel Ortiz: +1. For customer-facing audit events we agreed to validate schema upstream. We need a lightweight validator and reject bad events before KMS. Also rate-limit per org.
sre-bot: incident: audit-pipeline-backpressure triggered ⚠️ (see runbook: https://internal/runbooks/audit-ingest)
Akshat Patel: short-term ops fixes: 1) apply org-level sampling (sample 10% for noisy tenants) 2) increase Kafka producer linger.ms to 200ms for batching 3) limit KMS concurrency to 50 and fallback to unsigned blob with retention flag.
Maria Chen: can we add a blacklist of high-cardinality fields? resource_attrs.* exploded mapping in ES.
Lee Gomez: yes, drop unknown nested attributes, serialize extras into compressed 'meta_blob'. That keeps mapping stable.
Nora Li: propose config snippet for ingestion consumer:
```
{"audit_ingest.batch_size": 500,
 "audit_ingest.batch_bytes": 5000000,
 "audit_ingest.max_kms_concurrency": 50,
 "audit_ingest.org_sampling": {"default": 1.0, "noisy_orgs": 0.1}}
```
Akshat Patel: also consider protobuf compact encoding instead of JSON; reduces bytes on wire and ES indexing costs.
Daniel Ortiz: for customer-facing validation, we should return a 4xx with error details (not partial accept). Customers must fix schema. For strict customers we can provide 'lenient' workspace to accept and normalize.
Maria Chen: long-term: per-org ingestion quotas + alerting when quota breaches, plus offline replay with normalization.
Lee Gomez: indexing strategy: use sparse fields, dynamic templates in ES to map resource_attrs.* to disabled or keyword based on pattern.
Nora Li: immediate playbook I'm adding to runbook: apply org sampling, enable gzip compression on producers, temp increase shard refresh interval to 30s, and create DLQ for malformed events.
Daniel Ortiz: we should also run a vuln triage — KMS usage pattern revealed possible overprivileged service account; I'm opening a ticket.
Akshat Patel: I'll prototype a batching KMS signer: sign batch digests instead of each event. Perf looks ~6x better in local tests.
Maria Chen: awesome. Can one of you own rollout for the validator schema? need gating and customer communication.
Daniel Ortiz: I'll own the customer-facing message and escalation plan. Drafting now.
Lee Gomez: I'll handle ES index templates and mapping changes, will coordinate maintenance window.
Nora Li: I'll push the ingest config change (batching + gzip) and monitor Kafka lag.
Maria Chen: thanks — let's sync in 30 to confirm ops changes. :thumbsup:
